notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Great Whale.
When Great Whale dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Great Whale's power.
Repeat.
If the lands can tap to produce at least {5}, this combo nets infinite mana.
